theorem T03 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0 := by
  intro m N M htr hDu hDv hM hN
  have htrM : m.a * M + m.d * M < 0 := by
    have h := Int.mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos htr hM
    simpa [Scope.Model.trJ, Int.add_mul] using h
  have hDu' : 0 ≤ m.Du := by omega
  have hDv' : 0 ≤ m.Dv := by omega
  have hNDu : 0 ≤ N * m.Du := Int.mul_nonneg hN hDu'
  have hNDv : 0 ≤ N * m.Dv := Int.mul_nonneg hN hDv'
  simp only [Scope.Model.modeTr]
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0
